extraction.name: CT-RATE
extraction.description: A public dataset pairing 3D medical images with corresponding textual reports
extraction.creator: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci, Sezgin Er, Chenyu Wang, Furkan Almas, Ayse Gulnihan Simsek, Sewal Nil Esirgun, Irem Dogan, Omer Faruk Durugol, Benjamin Hou, Suprosanna Shit, Weicheng Dai, Murong Xu, Hadrien Reynaud, Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen, Bastian Wittmann, Tamaz Amiranashvili, Enis Simsar, Mehmet Simsar, Emine Bensu Erdemir, Abdullah Alanbay, Anjany Sekuboyina, Berkan Lafci, Ahmet Kaplan, Zhiyong Lu, Malgorzata Polacin, Bernhard Kainz, Christian Bluethgen, Kayhan Batmanghelich, Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir, and Bjoem Menze
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The CT-RATE dataset was curated from 21,304 unique patients with 25,692 non-contrast 3D chest CT volumes and corresponding radiology text reports from Istanbul Medipol University Mega Hospital.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset was curated to have minimal missing data. An automated text classifier was used to extract multi-abnormality labels from radiology reports.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset includes non-contrast chest CT volumes acquired between May 2015 and January 2023, totaling 50,188 reconstructed CT volumes from 25,692 distinct CT experiments conducted on 21,304 unique patients.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: An automated text classifier, RadBERT, was finetuned to classify the remaining 24,692 reports and extract 18 abnormality labels.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The CT volumes were resized to achieve uniform spacing of 0.75 mm in the x-axis and y-axis and 1.5 mm in the z-axis. The CT volumes were then either center-cropped or padded to reach a consistent resolution of 480×480×240.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The CT volumes were converted to Hounsfield Unit (HU) values and clipped to a range of -1000 to 1000. During training, these values were normalized to a range of -1 to 1.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each report was annotated with 18 abnormalities for this finetuning procedure. The finetuned model’s precision, recall, and F1 scores show robust classification across abnormalities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The finetuned model’s precision, recall, and F1 scores, detailed in Supplementary Table2, show robust classification across abnormalities.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: The patients range in age from 18 to 102 years, with a mean of 48.8 years and a mode of 40 years. The sex distribution is 41.6% female and 58.4% male.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: RadBERT-RoBERTa-4m model was used for automated label extraction.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is fully open-source and plans to be extended with multi-abnormality segmentation and localization labels for 3D chest CT volumes in future work.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Patient privacy was upheld by anonymizing all chest CT volumes, associated metadata, and radiology text reports before conducting any computational analysis.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The open-source release of CT-RATE, CT-CLIP, and CT-CHAT addresses critical challenges in 3D medical imaging and lays the groundwork for future innovations in medical AI and improved patient care.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Biases inherent to the single-institution dataset may influence the self-supervised training.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset originates from a single geographic and clinical setting, which may limit the generalizability of the models to other populations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for multi-abnormality detection, case retrieval, and report generation.
